protocol.scope: ATQ only; DEF, coefficients, thresholds and score scales frozen
protocol.integration: paired conditional difference: old ATQ effect + optimum(mu) - optimum(0)
protocol.selection: war start before 2026-10-12T05:00Z; select by mean per-war RPS, lower is better; ties prefer zero and smaller coefficients
protocol.ranked: latest ended week only; never current-week attacks; leave-one-player-out same tier/week/attackerCV/defenderCV; min20 other attacks from2 other players
protocol.cohort: current family fixed, exploratory; historical observed clan participants and bounded TH are sensitivity analyses
protocol.qualityContext: tier and week are a context proxy; numerical battle modifier is not claimed to be observed on each ranked hit
limitations: Retrospective current-family reference and current/row-displayed CV can introduce bias.
Historical ClashSpot participants are not a complete historical member list.
Only observed attacks validate predictive scores, not counterfactual assignments.
Legend I is excluded pending weekly normalization.
